channel.title: Tool Site HOT
channel.description: Tool Site HOT lists only tool websites you can use right away — converters, formatters, image tools, code tools and more. It discovers the newest tool sites every day from Product Hunt, Hacker News and other tool sources, scores them by rules, and shows only the title, a one-line summary and a link to the original — no articles, no news, no full text republished.

item.title: Orthosetter: A Deterministic Typesetting Tool for Orthodox Music
item.description: A typesetting tool built for Orthodox church music that turns your scores into consistently formatted sheet music pages.

item.title: Archiver: Free In-Browser Tool to Extract and Create ZIP, 7z and RAR Archives
item.description: Extract and create ZIP, 7z, RAR and more right in your browser — files never leave your device, with encryption and repair for damaged archives.

item.title: Rezora IO: Launch an AI Voice Agent in 10 Minutes
item.description: Build an AI voice agent the way you'd set up a Shopify store — live and answering calls in ten minutes.

item.title: Nuko: Motion Design in Your Browser
item.description: Design motion graphics right in the browser — no install needed, just open it and start animating on the timeline.

item.title: Adside: A Team of AI Agents That Manage Your Paid Ads
item.description: A team of specialized AI agents manages your paid ads for you, from launch to optimization, without you watching over them.

item.title: Show HN: AI Kitchen Designer
item.description: Upload a photo of your kitchen or describe an idea, and AI redesigns the layout and style for you.

item.title: Show HN: AgentMall – Let your AI agent buy groceries
item.description: Reliable grocery checkout automation for personal AI agents, so your assistant can actually complete the order.

item.title: Show HN: Tool to compare your Claude.md and Agents.md against 40k public repos
item.description: Compare your Claude.md and Agents.md against 40,000 public repos to see how your agent setup stacks up.

item.title: Show HN: Cashcraft – free precise budgeting without categories
item.description: A free budgeting tool that keeps your numbers precise without making you categorize every transaction.

item.title: Vibes Matrix: Simplify Complex Life Decisions
item.description: Turns a tangled life decision into a clear comparison — free, no sign-up, right in the browser.

item.title: KlingVideo
item.description: A free Kling AI video generator that turns text or images into cinematic clips.

item.title: Oh So Video
item.description: Free in-browser video tools to compress, trim, caption, convert, and mute.

item.title: Room AI: Redesign Your Room by Talking to It Like a Designer
item.description: Talk to it like a designer and change your room one step at a time, seeing the result as you go.

item.title: Enrichable – open-source AI spreadsheet for data enrichment
item.description: Describe the list of companies or people you need and it fills the sheet, then add columns in plain English and let AI research every row on the live web, with sources for each answer.

item.title: mio click: A Fidget Toy That's Also a Friend
item.description: A fidget toy that lives in your browser — click away to unwind, with a little companion keeping you company.

item.title: Vybe: 18-Skill Website Analysis Tool
item.description: Paste in a URL for a free audit of your site — conversion, SEO, speed and 15 more checks in one pass, with the top fix listed first.

item.title: Tuix: an in-app feedback widget for web apps
item.description: Collect user feedback right inside your website, no more chasing screenshots over email, spreadsheets, or Slack.

item.title: CyberScore Labs
item.description: Type in a website address and get a free 20-second external security scan with a grade and a score out of 100.

item.title: Goodbye GTA 5 AI
item.description: Upload one photo and get a farewell video that takes you back to 2013 to say goodbye to the three GTA 5 leads on the pier.

item.title: Show HN: Evenleads – a live feed of freelance hiring asks
item.description: A live feed of people publicly asking to hire freelancers, so you can follow up and pitch your services.
